title: 第25章 欠我一条命第26章 不平等条约
slug: 圣殇天狱第1013章力战古神
content_zh:
黎明前的黑暗笼罩着大地，
阴邪之物缓缓地向更黑暗的角落隐没。
刚刚抬起黑爪的黑影后背汗毛倒竖，
一刹那收回抓心黑手趴在地上抽泣，
但挤都挤不出一滴黄泪，
‘呯’
黑爪往自己面部狠狠地拍下，
眼冒金星顿时鼻血涌出来，可惜美中不足，还是没有眼泪，
这是狠人，立刻倒在地上，
‘滋滋滋’
一道七彩光球燃烧撕裂着空气，从他头上一尺擦过，
高温烤焦了他的毛发，头皮发烫，
他嗅到了死亡气息，头皮发麻，
还好他对危险有特别的感知。
一道流光一霎那来到这里，
不是灵汐还是谁，不过还有一男一女跟随，
小灵汐的脸色有史以来的差，
因为她感应到云阳根本没有了呼吸心跳，血液冷却，
玉指一抬，
手上出现彩色火焰光球，

把如墨的夜晚照亮，
火焰光球烧的空气噼里啪啦乱响。
元罗哪还敢装死，这里现场就他一个活着的异类，光球明摆着是要杀他，灵汐的厉害他早在暗处观察的清清楚楚，
一骨碌翻身跪趴在地，丑陋的脸扭成一团；
‘哇哇哇，兄弟呀，同袍啊，呜呜呜，你咋就这样英年早逝呀，我们约好了还要一起喝酒逛窑子的啊，那些水灵灵的阿妹···’
‘呯’
已经魔化的元罗根本组织不好正常语言，还没有表演完就被隔空一指弹飞，
‘呯，嘭’
自由飞行几十丈重重的摔在地上，一个狗啃泥尖牙都松了两颗，不能出气。
灵汐冷冰冰的声音传来；
‘不要让本仙子再看见你在云阳身边出现’
元罗哪还管痛，连扑带爬的一溜烟消失在黑暗中，躲过一劫。
随来的女子声音很悦耳；
‘灵汐妹妹，看他不像好人，为什么不直接杀了他’
小灵汐到云阳身前蹲下，此刻她不知道为什么，看见傻木头真正的身死，一阵阵的心如刀绞；
‘傻木头活着的时候，没有继续追杀这个同乡家伙，身世很可怜，目前也没有必死的情况出现’
黑暗掩盖了悲伤，
她们没有发现灵汐的眼睛通红泛着泪光，
她的身体在微微发抖，一把抱起云阳冷冰冰的身体化作一道流光消失在黎明前的黑暗。
‘嘿，表妹，干嘛呢，等等我们’

两道流光划出两道弧线追了上去，
content_en:
The darkness before dawn covers the earth,
The evil things slowly disappeared into darker corners.
The hair on the back of the dark shadow that had just raised its black claw stood on end.
In an instant, he withdrew his grasping hands and lay on the ground sobbing.
But I can't squeeze out a drop of yellow tears,
‘Bang’
Black Claw slapped him hard on the face,
My eyes were filled with stars and blood suddenly came out from my nose. Unfortunately, there was a fly in the ointment, and there were still no tears.
This is a cruel person, he immediately fell to the ground,
‘Zizzizi’
A ball of colorful light burned and tore through the air, passing one foot past his head.
The high temperature scorched his hair and made his scalp feel hot.
He smelled the breath of death, his scalp was numb,
Fortunately, he has a special sense of danger.
A stream of light came here in an instant,
It’s not Lingxi or anyone else, but there is a man and a woman following,
Xiao Lingxi's face was the worst it had ever been.
Because she sensed that Yunyang had no breathing or heartbeat at all, and his blood was cold.
Lifting his jade finger,
Colorful flame light balls appeared on the hands,
Light up the inky night,
The air burned by the flame ball crackled.
How could Yuan Luo dare to pretend to be dead? He was the only living alien at the scene. The ball of light was clearly trying to kill him. He had clearly observed Ling tide's power in the dark.
Yi Gulu turned over and knelt on the ground, his ugly face twisted into a ball;
‘Wow, wow, wow, brother, comrade, wow, wow, why did you die so young? We made an appointment to drink and go to the brothel together, those pretty sisters...'
‘Bang’
The demonized Yuan Luo couldn't organize normal speech at all, and before he finished his performance, he was flicked away with a finger in the air.
‘Bang, bang’
After flying dozens of feet freely, he fell heavily to the ground. A dog chewed on the mud and two of its fangs were loosened, unable to vent its anger.
Lingxi's cold voice came;
‘Don’t let me see you next to Yunyang again’
Yuan Luo didn't care about the pain, he jumped and crawled and disappeared into the darkness, escaping the disaster.
The voice of the woman who followed was pleasant;
‘Sister Lingxi, he doesn’t look like a good person, why don’t you just kill him’
Little Lingxi knelt down in front of Yunyang. At this moment, she didn't know why, but when she saw Sha Mumu's real death, her heart felt like a knife.
"When Silly Wood was alive, he did not continue to hunt down this fellow countryman. His life experience was very pitiful, and there is currently no situation where he will die."
Darkness covers sadness,
They didn't notice that Lingxi's eyes were red and filled with tears.
Her body was trembling slightly, and she hugged Yunyang's cold body and turned it into a stream of light and disappeared into the darkness before dawn.
‘Hey, cousin, what are you doing, wait for us’
The two streams of light drew two arcs and chased after them.
